note: Identical baseline graph and deterministic filesystem clocks in both arms; returned rows are Node diagnostic counts, not CF native billed reads.

queries.q:
SELECT json_object('id',e.id,'path',e.path,'parent_path',e.parent_path,'name',e.name,'kind',e.kind,'content_class',e.content_class,'opaque_object_id',e.opaque_object_id,'link_target',e.link_target,'size_bytes',e.size_bytes,'mode',e.mode,'uid',e.uid,'gid',e.gid,'created_at_ms',e.created_at_ms,'link_identity',e.link_identity,'link_count',e.link_count,'modified_at_ms',e.modified_at_ms,'changed_at_ms',COALESCE(e.changed_at_ms, e.modified_at_ms),'revision',e.revision,'mutation_version',e.mutation_version) AS entry
       FROM vfs_entries e INDEXED BY vfs_entries_path
       WHERE e.path = ?

SELECT e.id AS id,e.path AS path,e.parent_path AS parent_path,e.name AS name,e.kind AS kind,e.content_class AS content_class,e.opaque_object_id AS opaque_object_id,e.link_target AS link_target,e.size_bytes AS size_bytes,e.mode AS mode,e.uid AS uid,e.gid AS gid,e.created_at_ms AS created_at_ms,e.link_identity AS link_identity,e.link_count AS link_count,e.modified_at_ms AS modified_at_ms,COALESCE(e.changed_at_ms, e.modified_at_ms) AS changed_at_ms,e.revision AS revision,e.mutation_version AS mutation_version,
          (SELECT json_group_array(json_array(path,kind,mode,uid,gid))
             FROM vfs_entries INDEXED BY vfs_entries_path
             WHERE path IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))) AS parents
       FROM (SELECT 1) seed
       LEFT JOIN vfs_entries e INDEXED BY vfs_entries_path ON e.path = ?

SELECT path, kind, mode, uid, gid
         FROM vfs_entries INDEXED BY vfs_entries_path
         WHERE path IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
BEGIN
SELECT inline_bytes, entries FROM vfs_usage WHERE singleton = 1

UPDATE vfs_usage SET
         inline_bytes = inline_bytes + ?, entries = entries + ?,
         next_ino = MAX(next_ino, ?)
       WHERE singleton = 1
COMMIT

UPDATE vfs_entries INDEXED BY vfs_entries_path SET modified_at_ms = ?, changed_at_ms = ?,
      revision = revision + 1, mutation_version = mutation_version + 1,
      link_count = link_count
      WHERE path IN (?) AND kind = 'directory'
      RETURNING path, mutation_version
